_comment: Reference list of test parameters, sourced from the Tucena schematic (sheet /MCU/, U1A = F28P650DK6PZP). Mirrors firmware/src/test_config.h - keep both in sync. The GUI itself doesn't parse this file to run tests (it just displays whatever the firmware reports over UART, see docs/protocol.md) - this exists so the parameter list is documented somewhere human-readable outside the C source.

uart.notes: DBG_UART_TX (GPIO70) / DBG_UART_RX (GPIO71) per schematic, on the UARTB peripheral (not SCI-B, not HMI_UART_TX/RX GPIO12/13 which is SCIA/uartHMI - confirmed via board pinmux sheet).

excluded_by_design._comment: Signals on the schematic deliberately not tested yet, and why

floating_no_net_this_rev._comment: Board's own pin function list says these 'do not go anywhere' / 'go nowhere' - excluded rather than tested, since reading a floating pin is noise, not a real PASS/FAIL

tests.name: ButtonON
tests.notes: assumes active-low w/ pull-up (idle = not pressed) - TODO confirm polarity

tests.name: Temp2_FLT
tests.notes: measured 0 on a fresh, room-temperature board (no real fault possible) - taken as the true no-fault state

tests.name: I_OC_Flt
tests.notes: measured 1 on the real board - active-low assumption held for this one

tests.name: BOOT1_STRAP
tests.notes: boot-mode strap pin - read-only, never drive this pin

tests.name: GPIO_BUZZ
tests.notes: buzzer will audibly sound during this test

tests.name: BUTTON_LED_ON
tests.notes: no physical (visual) verification yet - see docs/protocol.md future switch-box section

tests.notes: full-range placeholder - TODO narrow once sensor scaling is known
